entries.saved_application_writeup:
I’m motivated by the opportunity to build storage infrastructure that helps research and production teams move quickly without compromising reliability. My background spans unified object, block, and file storage; cross-region replication and recovery; erasure coding; backup and archival; and capacity efficiency. I’ve led cross-team infrastructure work and stayed hands-on with systems software, Linux, and production debugging.

I’ve also built a 1,500-node Kubernetes cluster for a proof-of-concept project. At Oracle, I developed backend capacity optimization for idle volumes (Patent 11,412,043) and drove CI/CD work for automated qualification and deployment. I’d bring this combination of storage depth, systems engineering, and practical infrastructure delivery to OpenAI’s Compute Storage team.
